note: Every shipped asset, path and size, and where it came from. sw.js precaches exactly this list, so a card that adds a sprite adds it here and never to sw.js. assets/source/** is deliberately not listed: those are the unmodified pack archives, kept as provenance, and the start screen must not wait on a 22MB download. Terms live in ATTRIBUTION.md.
placement: A board square is 64 native px. Every piece sprite is a tight crop of the 2D Chess Pack's top-down render with a 3px contrasting rim added; the game draws a piece at k = square/64 and stands it on the square, bottom-centred with its base on the square's bottom edge. The map is the same rule at a bigger size: every assets/map/*.png is a 2x export of an SVG source beside the packs in assets/source/map/ (which is not precached), cut or drawn at the size the map draws it — the drawn size is in each entry below — so a 64px stop is a 128px file and the terrain bands are 1040px wide for the map’s 520px column. The three terrain bands are one painting sliced at fixed rows, so a stitched edge is the same pixels and cannot show a seam.
